preview.overview: Baylor hosts Iowa State for the lineal championship belt on Friday night in Waco. The Bears are the current belt holder, but the Cyclones arrive as slight favorites in a rivalry that has tilted heavily in Iowa State's direction over the last five meetings.
key_matchups: Baylor's defensive performance against Iowa State's offensive firepower -- the Cyclones put up 45 points on West Virginia and 55 on Bowling Green, while Baylor has allowed 41 and 55 in recent losses
Iowa State's ability to limit explosive plays after surrendering 39 points to Arizona and 31 to Utah
Execution in close games, where Baylor won 23-13 over Colorado but lost 24-25 at Kansas, while Iowa State won 45-42 over West Virginia but fell 17-31 to Utah
preview.betting_angles: Iowa State holds a commanding 4-1 edge in the last five head-to-head matchups, including dominant wins of 43-21 in 2024 and 30-18 in 2023. Baylor's recent form is mixed -- two wins sandwiched around three losses -- while Iowa State has shown streaky inconsistency with wins over weaker competition (Bowling Green, West Virginia) offset by blowout losses to ranked teams (Arizona, BYU, Utah). The all-time series is nearly even at 12-11 Baylor, but Iowa State's recent dominance in the rivalry suggests momentum favors the visiting Cyclones.
preview.prediction_writeup: Iowa State's recent dominance in this rivalry is too significant to ignore. The Cyclones have won four of the last five meetings and claimed convincing victories of 43-21 and 30-18 in the two most recent matchups. While Baylor has steadied itself with consecutive wins over Arizona State and Colorado, those victories came against teams that gave up 55 and 23 points respectively, suggesting the Bears' defense remains vulnerable. Iowa State's offense has shown it can score in bunches when it faces teams without elite defenses, and Baylor's recent losses to Kansas and TCU indicate defensive lapses at critical moments. The road rivalry trend favors Iowa State, and their ability to outscore Baylor in three of the last four head-to-head contests suggests they can do it again.
